import factory
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date, timedelta
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from factory.django import DjangoModelFactory
from faker import Faker

from catalog.models import Author, Category, Book
from reviews.models import Review
from loans.models import Loan

User = get_user_model()
fake = Faker("fa_IR")


class UserFactory(DjangoModelFactory):
    class Meta:
        model = User
        django_get_or_create = ("username",)

    username = factory.Sequence(lambda n: f"user{n}")
    email = factory.LazyAttribute(lambda o: f"{o.username}@example.com")
    first_name = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.first_name())
    last_name = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.last_name())

    @factory.post_generation
    def password(obj, create, extracted, **kwargs):
        obj.set_password(extracted or "TestPass123!")
        if create:
            obj.save()

    @factory.post_generation
    def profile(obj, create, extracted, **kwargs):
        if create:
            from users.models import UserProfile
            UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=obj)


class AdminFactory(UserFactory):
    is_staff = True
    is_superuser = True


class AuthorFactory(DjangoModelFactory):
    class Meta:
        model = Author

    full_name = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.name())
    bio = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.text(max_nb_chars=300))
    nationality = "IR"


class CategoryFactory(DjangoModelFactory):
    class Meta:
        model = Category

    name = factory.Sequence(lambda n: f"Category {n}")
    description = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.sentence())


class BookFactory(DjangoModelFactory):
    class Meta:
        model = Book

    title = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.sentence(nb_words=4))
    subtitle = ""
    description = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.text(max_nb_chars=500))
    author = factory.SubFactory(AuthorFactory)
    isbn = factory.Sequence(lambda n: f"978{n:010d}")
    price = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: Decimal(fake.pydecimal(left_digits=4, right_digits=2, positive=True)))
    published_at = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.date_between(start_date="-10y", end_date="today"))
    pages = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.random_int(100, 1000))
    language = "fa"
    stock = 10
    total_copies = 10
    is_published = True
    owner = None


class ReviewFactory(DjangoModelFactory):
    class Meta:
        model = Review

    book = factory.SubFactory(BookFactory)
    user = factory.SubFactory(UserFactory)
    rating = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.random_int(1, 5))
    title = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.sentence())
    comment = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.text(max_nb_chars=300))
    is_approved = True


class LoanFactory(DjangoModelFactory):
    class Meta:
        model = Loan

    user = factory.SubFactory(UserFactory)
    book = factory.SubFactory(BookFactory)
    status = "active"
    borrowed_at = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: timezone.now())
    due_date = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: timezone.now() + timedelta(days=14))

import pytest
from decimal import Decimal
from rest_framework import status

from tests.factories import (
    UserFactory, AdminFactory, AuthorFactory, BookFactory, ReviewFactory,
)


@pytest.mark.django_db
@pytest.mark.integration
class TestUserJourney:
    """جریان کامل کاربر از ثبت‌نام تا امانت."""

    def test_register_and_browse(self, api_client):
        # ثبت‌نام
        register = api_client.post("/api/auth/register/", {
            "username": "sara",
            "email": "sara@example.com",
            "password": "S3cret!Pass",
            "password_confirm": "S3cret!Pass",
        }, format="json")
        assert register.status_code == status.HTTP_201_CREATED

        # تنظیم توکن
        api_client.credentials(HTTP_AUTHORIZATION=f"Bearer {register.data['access']}")

        # ساخت کتاب توسط ادمین
        admin = AdminFactory()
        book = BookFactory(author=AuthorFactory())

        # دیدن کتاب
        response = api_client.get("/api/books/")
        assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_200_OK
        assert response.data["count"] >= 1

    def test_loan_flow(self, authenticated_client, book):
        initial_stock = book.stock

        # امانت
        loan = authenticated_client.post(
            "/api/loans/", {"book": str(book.id)}, format="json",
        )
        assert loan.status_code == status.HTTP_201_CREATED

        book.refresh_from_db()
        assert book.stock == initial_stock - 1

        # بازگشت
        loan_id = loan.data["id"]
        returned = authenticated_client.post(
            f"/api/loans/{loan_id}/return_book/", format="json",
        )
        assert returned.status_code == status.HTTP_200_OK

        book.refresh_from_db()
        assert book.stock == initial_stock


@pytest.mark.django_db
class TestReviewFlow:
    def test_create_and_approve_review(self, authenticated_client, admin_client, book):
        # ساخت نظر
        response = authenticated_client.post(
            f"/api/books/{book.slug}/reviews/",
            {
                "book": str(book.id),
                "rating": 5,
                "comment": "کتاب عالی بود، حتماً بخوانید.",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_201_CREATED
        review_id = response.data["id"]

        # تأیید توسط ادمین
        approve = admin_client.post(
            f"/api/reviews/{review_id}/approve/", format="json",
        )
        assert approve.status_code == status.HTTP_200_OK


@pytest.mark.django_db
class TestPaymentFlow:
    def test_initiate_payment(self, authenticated_client):
        response = authenticated_client.post(
            "/api/payments/initiate/",
            {"tier": "basic", "gateway": "zarinpal"},
            format="json",
        )
        assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_201_CREATED
        assert "payment_url" in response.data

    def test_verify_payment(self, api_client, user, authenticated_client):
        # شروع
        init = authenticated_client.post(
            "/api/payments/initiate/",
            {"tier": "basic", "gateway": "zarinpal"},
            format="json",
        )
        payment_id = init.data["payment"]["id"]

        # تأیید (callback بدون auth)
        api_client.credentials()
        verify = api_client.post(
            f"/api/payments/{payment_id}/verify/",
            {"status": "success", "transaction_id": "tx_123"},
            format="json",
        )
        assert verify.status_code == status.HTTP_200_OK
        assert verify.data["status"] == "success"

        # بررسی اشتراک
        user.refresh_from_db()
        profile = user.profile
        profile.refresh_from_db()
        assert profile.subscription_tier == "basic"

FROM python:3.11-slim AS builder

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

WORKDIR /build

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential libpq-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --user -r requirements.txt

FROM python:3.11-slim

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PATH="/home/app/.local/bin:$PATH"

WORKDIR /app

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    libpq5 libmagic1 curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash app
COPY --from=builder --chown=app:app /root/.local /home/app/.local
COPY --chown=app:app . .

RUN mkdir -p /app/staticfiles /app/media /app/logs && chown -R app:app /app

USER app

EXPOSE 8000

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=20s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://localhost:8000/live/ || exit 1

ENTRYPOINT ["/app/docker/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["gunicorn", "library_system.wsgi:application", \
     "--bind", "0.0.0.0:8000", \
     "--workers", "3", \
     "--worker-class", "gthread", \
     "--threads", "2", \
     "--access-logfile", "-", \
     "--error-logfile", "-"]

#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "Waiting for database..."
until pg_isready -h "${DB_HOST}" -p "${DB_PORT:-5432}" -U "${DB_USER}" > /dev/null 2>&1; do
    sleep 1
done

echo "Waiting for Redis..."
until redis-cli -u "${REDIS_URL}" ping > /dev/null 2>&1; do
    sleep 1
done

if [ "$1" = "gunicorn" ]; then
    echo "Running migrations..."
    python manage.py migrate --noinput

    echo "Collecting static..."
    python manage.py collectstatic --noinput --clear
fi

exec "$@"

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE: library_system.settings.dev
  SECRET_KEY: test-secret-key

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'
      - run: pip install ruff black
      - run: ruff check .
      - run: black --check .

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: test_db
          POSTGRES_USER: test_user
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test_pass
        ports: [5432:5432]
        options: --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 5s --health-retries 5
      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports: [6379:6379]
    env:
      DB_NAME: test_db
      DB_USER: test_user
      DB_PASSWORD: test_pass
      DB_HOST: localhost
      REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/0
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
      - run: python manage.py migrate
      - run: pytest --cov=. --cov-report=xml --cov-fail-under=75
      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        if: always()

  security:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: pip install pip-audit
      - run: pip-audit --fail-on high

  schema:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      SECRET_KEY: schema-test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python manage.py spectacular --file /tmp/schema.yml --validate

name: CD

on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          push: true
          tags: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.ref_name }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_KEY }}
          script: |
            cd /var/www/library_system
            export TAG=${{ github.ref_name }}
            docker compose pull
            docker compose up -d --no-deps api celery celery-beat
            docker compose exec -T api python manage.py migrate --noinput

      - name: Health check
        run: |
          sleep 10
          curl -f https://api.example.com/health/ || exit 1

# Library System API

سیستم مدیریت کتابخانه دیجیتال با Django REST Framework.

## ویژگی‌ها

- احراز هویت JWT با Rotation و Blacklist
- مدیریت کاربران و اشتراک‌ها
- CRUD کتاب، نویسنده، دسته‌بندی
- نظرات، امتیازات و تأیید
- امانت و رزرو با صف انتظار
- پرداخت و اشتراک
- اعلان‌ها با ایمیل
- گزارش‌ها و آمار
- مستندات OpenAPI
- Docker + CI/CD
- Sentry + Prometheus

## پیش‌نیازها

- Python 3.11+
- PostgreSQL 16+
- Redis 7+
- Docker & Docker Compose

## راه‌اندازی سریع

```bash
# کلون
git clone <repo>
cd library_system

# کپی env
cp .env.example .env
# ویرایش .env

# Docker
docker compose up -d --build

# Migrations
docker compose exec api python manage.py migrate
docker compose exec api python manage.py createsuperuser
```

## دسترسی

- API: http://localhost:8000/api/
- Admin: http://localhost:8000/admin/
- Docs: http://localhost:8000/api/docs/
- Health: http://localhost:8000/health/

## تست

```bash
pytest --cov=. --cov-report=html
```

## ساختار

- `common/` — ابزارهای مشترک
- `users/` — احراز هویت
- `catalog/` — کتاب و نویسنده
- `reviews/` — نظرات
- `favorites/` — علاقه‌مندی
- `loans/` — امانت و رزرو
- `payments/` — اشتراک و پرداخت
- `notifications/` — اعلان‌ها
- `reports/` — گزارش‌ها
